hook.name: ExponentialLiquidityHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook for token launches paired with WBTC. Deploys ERC20 tokens (PackERC20) with liquidity distributed across exponential price segments. After each swap, if the price crosses a threshold, the hook removes all liquidity, transfers WBTC proceeds to the token contract, and enables a Chainlink VRF-based pack-opening mechanic. Pool initialization is restricted to the hook's own deployERC20Token function via a reverting beforeInitialize.
